David worked in the lab from June 2020 to May 2023 as a fellow in Pulmonary and
Critical Care Medicine at Massachusetts General Hospital. He studied how lung
fibroblast metabolism changes during myofibroblast differentiation and how this
impacts the development of pulmonary fibrosis.
